entityDescription:
COUNTERFOG EBT DE LA UAH SL is a spin-off company of Universidad de Alcalá. In 2013 a team led by professor Pérez-Díaz was granted by the Seventh Framework Program of the European Commission to research on aerosol and fog dynamics and to develop a technology to decontaminate chemical, biological, and radiological and nuclear agents in air and surfaces. A consortium of 10 institutions from Spain, the United Kingdom, Germany, the Czech Republic, Bulgaria, and Sweden built a Fog Dynamics Laboratory and created Counterfog®. A unique technology that creates a dynamical cone of fog that scavenges air-borne particulate matter including smoke, powder, and any kind of aerosols.

Counterfog® demonstrated to provide a rapid, cheap, and large-scale response for collapsing all kinds of air-borne dispersed agents –including Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear agents as well as other air-borne micro-particles like those in smoke. Counterfog® nozzles create aconical jet of fog made of nanometric droplets that collapse and catch air-borne micrometric particles and pollutants. It was demonstrated to be effective against aerosols of Bacillus thuringiensis and their spores -a surrogate of Bacillus Anthracis-.Moreover, 99.99% effectivenesswas demonstrated after 1 minute of Counterfog® application. In summary, the Counterfog® applications are:

Covid Disinfection: Counterfog® technology traps viruses with micro-droplets of water, aggregating and precipitating them to the soil, where they can be properly treated.

Smoke control: Using only water and air, Counterfog®collapses clouds of smoke in minutes, achieving healthy environments that are not harmful to people’s health.

Toxic clouds (CBRN): Counterfog®has been successfully used in simulated accidents or terrorist attacks with chemical, bacteriological, radiological, or nuclear agents.

Counterfog® technology and products are used by public entities and private companies in various countries around the world.

entityDescription: One of the main obstacles in satellite imagery is the presence of clouds, which limits the capability to make observations and ultimately to take optimal decisions – especially in missions with long revisit times. ClearSky Vision addresses these problems by integrating data from various missions (Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, and more) and using a novel neural network architecture to predict urban and landscape changes underneath cloud cover. This will allow for more consistent and frequent retrieval of multi-spectral cloudless satellite imagery and indices that are crucial to improved time-series analysis and anomaly detection. This is particularly beneficial within agriculture, natural disasters, and environmental monitoring. We utilize data from transparent clouds, partly cloudy images, and historical data to predict the most up-to-date cloudless satellite image possible.

Latvia University of Life Sciences and Technologies (previously called Latvia University of Agriculture) (hereinafter LLU) is the state founded multi-profile higher education and research institution under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, specializing in the sustainable use of natural resources aimed at the enhancement of quality of life for society.
LLU is a multi-disciplinary university with 3845 students (2019). The number of academic staff is 213, the number of leading researchers and researchers is 280. There are 8 faculties, 60 study programmes of various levels. The total budget of the university is 33.89 million EUR (2019), out of which 11.68 million EUR are allocated for the research and development and 13.42 million EUR for development of the infrastructure.
 
LLU provides higher academic and higher professional education in agriculture, veterinary medicine, food technology, engineering and forestry sciences, social science, information technologies and environmental management and develops research-based learning opportunities.
The mission of LLU is to develop competitive intellectual capital on the basis of excellence in research, application of research findings, high quality of education and effective management of the university. LLU implements research activities in the directions of Life Sciences, Engineering and technology, as well as Social sciences. LLU specialization is based on the university knowledge and competence in usage of biotic and abiotic nature resources. Research for bioeconomy and circular economy is at the focus of LLU. Multidisciplinary approach is applied at the each single stage of the bioeconomy and circular economy and research direction, providing results, which altogether lead towards novel, interdisciplinary developed solutions.
LLU has experience in management and implementation of various national, international and EU programme research, development, education and innovation projects. Local, regional and international cooperation is established with universities, scientific institutes, centres of technology transfer and SMEs since LLU is a member of different regional and international co-operation networks. Thus LLU has profound experience with remarkable results in implementing research, development, communication and innovation projects.
 
For more information about LLU look at www.llu.lv/en.

ARMINES (www.armines.net) is a private non-profit research and technological organisation (RTO) funded in 1967.
The association, a research and knowledge dissemination organisation, aims to carry out the following actions, mainly on behalf of its Full Members :

- To undertake and carry out, internally or in collaboration, research and study activities in the scientific, technical and economic fields.
- To manage the administration and monitoring of the execution of the contractualisation of these research and study/analysis actions, including national or European public co-financing,

- To contribute to the dissemination of technical, scientific and economic knowledge,
- To enhance the results of the research actions carried out by transferring the resulting technologies,

- To provide training in oriented research, with a view to the dissemination and application of the results of research activities in industry,
- To contribute to the improvement of engineers and executives by providing them with the means for permanent training, such as continuing education through Specialised Masters,
- To collect scientific documentation corresponding to its activity and to distribute it in the interested circles,
- To contribute to the promotion of the scientific excellence of French public research.
